about: Invented moments. scripts/mobile/vectors.ts formats each with the window's own functions (packages/core/inbox-format.ts) in each time zone named here, and writes vectors/time.json. UTC, a fixed +05:30 (Asia/Kolkata) and America/Los_Angeles (-08:00 in November, -07:00 in summer), so an app that formats in UTC instead of the zone it is given fails.
